findings.title: Do not mark source accuracy PASS without reviewing the canonical claim and its sources
findings.body: The fresh-reader evidence did not inspect `docs/site/status/acceptance.md` or either declared source dependency (`.github/workflows/remediation-native.yaml` and `tests/verification/contracts/check-production-receipt-attestation.mjs`): the navigation manifest omits them, and the participant states that no implementation source was inspected before execution. This leaves the original item's `pending-current-claim-inspection` unresolved. The completed local exercise can support reader usability, but it cannot establish that the canonical acceptance claim remains source-accurate; inspect and record those current sources before assigning PASS or clearing `openIssues`.

overall_explanation: sourceAccuracy=NOT_READY; readerUsability=PASS; quality=PASS; WHOLE_QUA006=NOT_READY. The fresh model reader completed the documented local compiled-workflow journey and a relevant ownership-boundary safe stop, while disclosed setup and cleanup limitations do not by themselves demonstrate a material reader-documentation defect. However, the required current source verification for the canonical QUA-006 claim is still absent, so the proposed PASS cannot close the whole original requirement.
